title: The Holy Spirit's Unshakeable Peace
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner delves into John 14:15-31, where Jesus reveals the incredible role of the Holy Spirit in our lives, promising to send a Comforter, a Helper, and a Strengthener to be with us forever. As Pastor Chris breaks down Jesus' words, listeners will discover the peace that the world can't give and the incredible power of the Holy Spirit to uplift and support them in a troubled world. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the amazing revelation of Jesus' love and presence in our lives.
